response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS telescope_share FROM telescopes AS t GROUP BY t.observstation ORDER BY telescope_share DESC, t.observstation ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The ranking includes stations with at least one telescope; share is a proportion from 0 to 1.

alternatives.interpretation: Include observatory stations with zero telescopes in the ranking.
alternatives.sql: SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS telescope_share FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY telescope_share DESC, o.observstation ASC LIMIT 10;

alternatives.interpretation: Include observatory stations with zero telescopes in the ranking.
